oneOf.description: Between the extension lines, pointing out at them.
Outside the extension lines, pointing in at them.

BoardCutout.description: A closed shape inside the Board Outline where board material is removed.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

vertices.description: The contour; the last vertex joins the first.

BoardOutline.description: The closed shape of the board's physical edge.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

vertices.description: The contour, counter-clockwise or not; the last vertex joins the first.

fab_notes.description: Free text for the fab, copied into the Fab Notes; left out when unset.

zone_name_scheme.description: How Zones with no typed name are named; left out for `NET_LXX_PXXX`.

Bounds.description: A range of sizes: `min` and `max` are limits, `preferred` is what Tools start with.

max.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

min.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

preferred.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

ComponentRef.description:
Which Component an object refers to: its UUID, after the Sheet Instance path that
leads to it. In v0.1 sheets are flat and the path is always empty.

path.description: The Sheet Instances from the top sheet down. Empty in v0.1.

ComponentType.description:
What kind of part a Part is: it decides what the Part needs and where it may be
placed, and gives the defaults for In BOM and In CPL, which are separate flags.

oneOf.description:
An ordinary part: it needs a Symbol and a Footprint, and reaches the board only
through Sync.

A part with a Symbol, a Footprint or both, such as a screw, a heat sink or a
mounting hole. It may be placed straight onto the board.

A deliberate short between Nets, made of touching Pads. It syncs like a Standard
part and is never Not Fitted.

ConnectionStyle.description: How a fill meets a Pad or Via.

oneOf.description: Through spokes across a clear ring, so the Pad solders easily.
The fill runs straight into it.
The fill keeps the gap clear and doesn't connect.

CopperEntry.description: The copper of one copper Layer.

thickness.description: The copper thickness; 1 oz is exactly 35 µm.

Corner.description: A corner of a Pad, in its own frame (+y up).

DesignRule.description: One design rule record: the values it sets for one kind, within one scope.

enabled.description:
Whether the record counts; left out when it does. A disabled board-wide limit is
absent, but its preferred values still supply routing defaults.

DielectricEntry.description: A dielectric between two copper Layers. Dielectrics are Stackup entries, not Layers.

thickness.description: Its thickness; left out, it takes the remainder of the Stackup's thickness.

Dimension.description:
A linear Dimension: the distance from `a` to `b` measured along `rotation`.

The dimension line runs along `rotation`, `offset` to the left of `a` (seen looking
along `rotation`). An extension line runs from `gap` off each end's point to `gap`
beyond the dimension line.

arrow_length.description: With `outside` arrows, how far the dimension line runs past each extension line.

arrow_size.description: The length of each side of an arrowhead.

extension_width.description: The pen width of the extension lines.

font.description: The named family. A missing family draws as bundled Noto Sans.

gap.description:
How far each extension line stops short of its point, and runs past the
dimension line.

layer.description: The Layer it is drawn on.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

offset.description: The signed distance of the dimension line from `a`, to the left of `rotation`.

prefix.description: Text before the value; left out when empty.

rotation.description: The direction measured along, counter-clockwise from +x.

suffix.description: Text after the value; left out when empty.

text_gap.description: The space between the dimension line and the text.

thickness.description: Stroke-font pen width; outline fonts ignore it.

width.description: The pen width of the dimension line and arrows.

point.description: Where the end is. While it has a `ref`, this is kept on the Hotspot.

ref.description: The Hotspot it follows; left out for an end in free space.

DimensionFormat.description: How a Dimension's value and unit are written.

oneOf.description: No value: only the prefix and suffix.
`top` when the text fits between the extension lines, else `right`.
Centred on the dimension line.
Centred, above the dimension line as the text reads.
Centred, below the dimension line as the text reads.
On the dimension line, outside the left extension line as the text reads.
On the dimension line, outside the right extension line as the text reads.
Above the line, inside against the left extension line.
Above the line, inside against the right extension line.
Centred above the line and always horizontal, whatever the Dimension's angle.
At this anchor, along the dimension line, with the style's `justify`.

DimensionUnits.description: The units a Dimension's value is shown in.

oneOf.description: Millimetres: a board stores no display units in v0.1.

DrcSeverities.description:
The severity of every DRC check, stored next to the rules. A check left out has its
default.

annular_ring.description: An annular ring below the minimum.

clearance.description: Clearance between copper of different Nets.

dangling.description:
Tracks and Vias that end unconnected, ignoring stubs up to the `dangling`
tolerance.

dead_copper.description: A kept piece of fill touching no copper of its Net, above the `dead_copper` area.

duplicate_copper.description: Health check: Tracks or Vias that repeat one another exactly.

edge_clearance.description: Copper too close to the Board Outline or a Board Cutout.

empty_zone.description: A Zone with a Net and nothing left to fill.

footprint_outside_board.description: A Footprint outside the Board Outline.

hole_size.description: A Pad, Free Pad or non-plated hole outside the `hole_size` range.

hole_to_hole.description: Holes closer than the minimum spacing.

keepout.description: An object inside a Keepout that forbids it.

micro_segment.description: Health check: a Track no longer than the `micro_segment` length.

net_tie_not_joined.description: A Net Tie's Footprint that isn't a valid tie.

opening_collapsed.description: A negative mask or paste expansion leaves no opening.

out_of_sync.description: The PCB out of sync with the schematic.

poor_connection.description: A Track end touching copper, with its centre outside that copper.

rule_invalid.description: A rule record with a blocking problem, which only a hand edit or a merge can cause.

rule_outside_preset.description: A rule that allows less than a Fab Preset limit.

shelved_zone.description: A shelved Zone, whose copper outputs leave out.

shorted_copper.description: Pads with different numbers touching on a Part that isn't a Net Tie.

silk_to_edge.description: Silkscreen closer than `silk_to_edge` to the Board Outline or a Board Cutout.

silk_to_mask.description: Silkscreen closer than `silk_to_mask` to exposed copper or a mask opening.

track_width.description: A Track narrower than the minimum or wider than the maximum.

via_size.description: A Via diameter or hole outside the `via_size` range.

via_under_smd.description: A Via inside an SMD Pad.

zero_area_zone.description: Health check: a Zone whose outline encloses no area.

zero_length_track.description: Health check: a Track whose ends coincide.

EditedFrom.description:
The copy a Locally Edited Footprint came from (ADR-0013): that copy's UUID in the same
part table and its content hash, which Sync compares with the schematic's copy.

Fields.description: A Part's default fields, copied onto each Component placed from it.

custom.description: Free-form fields, such as `LCSC` or `DigiKey`, in the user's order.

FootprintCopyRow.description:
One copied Footprint: a `.redafp` file's keys in one row. The PCB file's part table
uses the same rows.

edited_from.description: On a PCB's Locally Edited Footprint: the copy it was edited from.

hash.description: The content hash of the Footprint, as copied.

provenance.description: Where the Footprint was imported from, as in a `.redafp` file.

FootprintGraphic.description: One shape a Footprint draws on a non-copper Layer.

fill.description: Whether a closed shape is filled.

FootprintInstance.description:
One Footprint placed on the board.

A Footprint instance synced from the schematic is linked to its Component by
[`FootprintInstance::component`] and carries its own copy of the Component's
Designator, fields, Component Type, In BOM, In CPL and Not Fitted, so outputs read only
the PCB Document. A Mechanical
Part placed directly on the PCB has no Component link.

at.description: Where the Footprint origin sits on the board.

component.description:
The Component it shows (Sheet Instance path + Component UUID); left out for a
Mechanical Part that exists only on the PCB.

footprint.description: The PCB Document's Footprint copy it is placed from.

graphics_unlocked.description:
Its Footprint's graphics can be edited on the board, each edit making a Locally
Edited Footprint (ADR-0013).

in_bom.description: Whether it goes into the BOM.

in_cpl.description: Whether it goes into the CPL.

pads.description: One entry per Pad of the Footprint copy, sorted by Pad UUID.

rotation.description: Counter-clockwise, applied after flipping to the bottom side.

text_overrides.description: Sparse placement/style overrides, sorted by the UUID of the Footprint text entry.

FootprintLayer.description: The Layers a Footprint draws on besides copper.

height.description: The part's greatest height above the board, when known.

FootprintText.description: One field text of a Footprint, on a Silkscreen or Assembly Layer.

at.description:
The text anchor, relative to the Footprint origin; `style.justify` says how the
text sits on it.

field.description:
The field it shows: `Designator`, `Value` or any field name. A field the Component
does not have draws nothing.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

FreePad.description:
A Pad placed directly on the board, belonging to no Footprint: a mounting hole, a
fiducial or a test point. It has the whole Pad model, in board coordinates.

at.description: The Pad's anchor: the hole sits there, Tracks connect there and it turns about it.

chamfer_ratio.description: How deep the chamfers of a `chamfered_rect` are.

corner_ratio.description:
How round the corners of a `rounded_rect`, or the uncut corners of a
`chamfered_rect`, are.

corners.description: Which corners are rounded or chamfered, in the Pad's frame. Left out, all four.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

hole.description: The drilled hole; SMD Pads have none, the others must.

kind.description: SMD (plated, no hole), plated through-hole, or non-plated (a bare hole).

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

net.description:
Its PCB Net; left out for a Pad on no Net. Non-plated Pads have no copper and no
Net.

offset.description: Where the copper sits relative to `at`, in the Pad's frame. Left out, on it.

side.description: The board side of an SMD Pad. Left out, the top. Pads with a hole have none.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

zone_connection.description: How Zone fills of its Net join it. Each value left out inherits.

oneOf.description: A straight line.

A circular arc from `from` to `to`, sweeping `sweep` (counter-clockwise when
positive).

sweep.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

oneOf.description:
An axis-aligned rectangle with opposite corners `from` and `to`, outlined, or
filled as well when `filled`.

Hole.description:
A drilled hole: round when `width == height`, otherwise a slot along the longer side.
Sizes are the finished diameter.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

rotation.description: Turns a slot in the Pad's frame, counter-clockwise.

tolerance.description:
The allowed deviation from the finished size. Stored and shown; it changes no
geometry.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

HoleTolerance.description: How far a finished hole may come out larger (`plus`) or smaller (`minus`).

minus.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

plus.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

Hotspot.description: Which point of an object a [`HotspotRef`] names.

oneOf.description: A Footprint's origin.
The centre of a Free Pad or Via, or of an arc Track or arc graphic.
The start of a Track or line or arc graphic.
The end of a Track or line or arc graphic.
A free text's anchor.
The centre of the Pad with this UUID in a Footprint's copy.

A vertex, counted from 0, of an outline, cutout, Zone (its outline's when it follows
the Board Outline), Zone Cutout, Keepout or rectangle graphic
(corners `from`, (`to.x`, `from.y`), `to`, (`from.x`, `to.y`)).

HotspotRef.description: A Hotspot of one object on the board.

object.description:
The object: a Footprint, Free Pad, Via, Track, graphic, text, Board Outline, Board
Cutout, Zone, Zone Cutout or Keepout.

Keepout.description:
An area on one copper Layer, or on every copper Layer, where the kinds of object it
restricts may not go. Copper keeps the normal clearance from it unless the board-wide
`clearance` rule sets `zero_keepout_clearance`. It has no Net and is never plotted.

layer.description: The copper Layer; left out for every copper Layer.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

KeepoutShapeKind.description: Which [`KeepoutShape`] a Keepout has, as the file spells it.

Layer.description: One Layer. Objects name their Layer by UUID, never by position.

side.description: The board face, for sided Layers; left out for the others.

LayerKind.description: What a Layer is for. Copper and the sided kinds come with a [`Side`].

LayerSet.description:
The PCB Document's Layers as one ordered list, top to bottom. A generic list, so more
copper Layers need no format change.

LayerSpan.description:
The copper Layers a Via joins: every copper Layer from `from` to `to` in Layer order.
`from` is the upper Layer, so a through Via is stored top to bottom. `from` is also the
side it is drilled from, which matters only once blind Vias come.

expansion.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

Net.description: A PCB Net: Pads, Tracks, Vias and Zones name it by UUID.

classes.description:
The Net Classes it is in besides the Default Net Class, which every Net is in;
left out when there are none.

color.description:
Its colour as `#rrggbb`, for its Ratsnest lines (and its copper with Net colours
on); left out when unset. No manufacturing output reads it.

loop_removal.description:
Whether a route that closes a loop on this Net removes the old path; left out when
on. Off for power and ground Nets that need loops.

NetClass.description:
A named, ranked group of Nets that share design rules. Its values are the rule records
scoped to it. The Default Net Class is not stored: it is the board-wide records.

rank.description:
Its rank, unique on the board: 1 ranks highest. Where a Net's classes set the same
value, the highest-ranked class wins; the Default Net Class ranks below them all.

OutputOrigin.description:
The point the editor measures coordinates and grid from, and manufacturing files use
when a Fab Preset requests a relative origin. A PCB Document has at most one.

Pad.description: A copper area, with or without a hole, of a Footprint.

at.description:
The Pad's anchor, relative to the Footprint origin: the hole sits there, Tracks
connect there and the Pad turns about it.

chamfer_ratio.description: How deep the chamfers of a `chamfered_rect` are.

corner_ratio.description:
How round the corners of a `rounded_rect`, or the uncut corners of a
`chamfered_rect`, are.

corners.description:
Which corners are rounded (`rounded_rect`) or chamfered (`chamfered_rect`), in the
Pad's frame. Left out, all four.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

hole.description: A round hole when width equals height, otherwise a slot. SMD Pads have none.

mask.description: Per-side solder-mask expansion or tenting; omitted values inherit the board's rule.

offset.description: Where the copper sits relative to `at`, in the Pad's frame. Left out, on it.

paste.description: An SMD Pad's paste opening; omitted, it inherits the board's rule.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

side.description:
The side of an SMD Pad, in the Footprint's frame. Left out, the top. Pads with a
hole have none: their copper is on every Layer.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

zone_connection.description: How Zone fills of its Net join it. Each value left out inherits.

PadNet.description: The Net a Pad of a Footprint instance is on.

net.description: Its PCB Net; left out for a Pad on no Net.

pad.description: The Pad of the Footprint copy.

oneOf.description: A rectangle with rounded corners: `corner_ratio`, on `corners`.

A rectangle with `corners` cut off by `chamfer_ratio`, the others rounded by
`corner_ratio`. An octagon is one.

expansion.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

corner_ratio.description: Thousandths of a percent of half the shorter side: 100000 is fully round.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

PcbGraphic.description: A line, arc or rectangle drawn on a PCB Layer with a round pen.

layer.description: The Layer it is drawn on.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

PcbText.description:
Free text on a PCB Layer.

`position` is its justification anchor. Mirroring and rotation apply about it.

font.description: The named family. A missing family draws as bundled Noto Sans.

layer.description: The Layer it is drawn on.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

mirrored.description: Drawn mirrored, so it reads from below; only on bottom Layers. Left out when false.

position.description: The anchor of the text block or Text Frame.

text.description: The text; `\n` starts a new line.

thickness.description: Stroke-font pen width; outline fonts ignore it.

Point.description: A position on a Schematic Sheet or the PCB Document, which share one coordinate type.

x.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

y.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

PourOver.description: How a Zone's fill treats copper of its own Net.

oneOf.description: Same-Net Zones merge; same-Net Tracks keep clear by the clearance.
Same-Net Zones and Tracks merge.
Same-Net Zones and Tracks keep clear by the clearance.

Provenance.description:
Where an imported Library element came from, kept with the element so its terms travel
with it: vendor parts stay under the vendor's terms after import.

copyright.description: Copyright lines found in the imported files, kept verbatim.

service.description: The service the files came from, such as `SnapMagic`, or `Unknown`.

terms_url.description: The service's terms of use, when known.

Restriction.description: A kind of object a Keepout keeps out.

oneOf.description: Zone fills.
Through-hole Pads, plated or not.

Footprints, by their Courtyard (or fallback box) on the Keepout's side, with no
clearance. REDA's own addition.

Clearance between copper of different Nets: `value`, `ignore_pad_to_pad`,
`zero_keepout_clearance` (board-wide only).
Track width: `min`, `preferred`, `max?`.
Via size: `diameter` and `hole`, each `{min, preferred, max?}`.
Pad, Free Pad and non-plated hole size: `min`, `max`.
Annular ring: `min`.
Spacing between hole edges: `min`.
Copper to the Board Outline, Board Cutouts and non-plated hole edges: `value`.
Silkscreen to the Board Outline and Board Cutouts: `value`.
Silkscreen to exposed copper or mask openings: `value`, `mode`.
Spacing between courtyards: `value`.
Dangling stubs up to `tolerance` long pass.

Kept pieces of fill touching no copper of their Net, above `min_area`, are flagged.

RuleScope.description:
Where a rule record applies: filters that must all match. Empty is board-wide; v0.1
accepts only empty or `{net_class}`.

net_class.description: The Net Class whose Nets it applies to.

RuleValues.description:
The values a rule record sets. Which ones a record may hold depends on its kind
([`RuleKind::fields`]); every one left out is inherited.

bottom.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

diameter.description: Via size only: the Via's copper diameter.

expansion.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

hole.description: Via size only: the Via's drilled hole.

ignore_pad_to_pad.description: Clearance only: Pads within one Footprint need no clearance from each other.

max.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

max_length.description: `micro_segment` only: Tracks up to this long are micro-segments.

min.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

min_area.description: `dead_copper` only: pieces of fill up to this area, in square nanometres, pass.

mode.description: `silk_to_mask` only: what silkscreen keeps its distance from.

percent.description: Signed change in area in percent, strictly above -100.

preferred.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

smd.description: `zone_connection` only: how fills join SMD Pads.

through_hole.description: `zone_connection` only: how fills join through-hole Pads.

tolerance.description: `dangling` only: stubs up to this long pass.

top.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

value.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

zero_keepout_clearance.description: Clearance only, board-wide only: every Keepout edge is exact, with no clearance.

Severity.description: How a check's Violations are reported.

Shape.description: A drawn shape. Lines, arcs and outlines are stroked with the graphic's width.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned rectangle between two opposite corners.

The arc from `start` around `center`, sweeping `sweep` counter-clockwise (negative
is clockwise).

sweep.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

radius.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

oneOf.description: A closed polygon through its corners.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

Side.description: Which face of the board a sided Layer is on.

oneOf.description: The exposed copper: the copper inside each resolved mask opening.
The resolved mask openings themselves.

Stackup.description:
The board's physical build, top to bottom. v0.1 boards hold one; the table leaves room
for more stacks later, such as rigid-flex substacks.

entries.description:
The copper and dielectric entries, top to bottom: copper, dielectric, copper, and so
on, with one copper entry per copper Layer in Layer order.

finish.description: The surface finish, as typed; left out when unset.

mask_color.description: The solder mask colour, as typed; left out when unset.

silk_color.description: The silkscreen colour, as typed; left out when unset.

anyOf.description: Board material between two copper Layers.

StackupEntry.description: One entry of a [`Stackup`]. Solder mask, silkscreen and paste are not entries.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

TextJustify.description: How a text block sits on its anchor. Bottom is the last line's baseline.

margin.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

TextOverride.description: An instance changes only the properties present here; the Footprint supplies the rest.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

TextStyle.description: The shared style of free PCB text and Footprint field text.

font.description: The named family. A missing family draws as bundled Noto Sans.

thickness.description: Stroke-font pen width; outline fonts ignore it.

Track.description: One copper segment on a copper Layer. A route is a chain of Tracks that share ends.

layer.description: The copper Layer it is on.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

net.description: Its PCB Net; left out for copper on no Net.

width.description: The copper width; the ends are round.

TrackGeometry.description: The centreline of a [`Track`]. v0.1 creates only lines.

oneOf.description: A straight segment.

A circular arc from `from` to `to`, sweeping `sweep` (counter-clockwise when
positive).

sweep.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

Vertex.description: One corner of a contour and the edge that leaves it towards the next vertex.

sweep.description:
The edge to the next vertex: left out (or 0) for a straight edge, otherwise an arc
sweeping this angle, counter-clockwise when positive.

x.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

y.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

Via.description: A plated hole joining copper on the Layers of its span.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

net.description: Its PCB Net; left out for a Via on no Net.

Waiver.description:
A recorded acceptance that one Violation is intentional, so checks stop reporting it.

It is stored in the Document that holds the objects involved, and matches a Violation
of the same check whose objects are exactly these, in any order. Once those objects no
longer break the check together, it matches nothing.

author.description: Preference `user.name` at the instant this Waiver was created.

check.description: The check id of the waived Violation, such as `unconnected_pin` or `clearance`.

created.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC, from the injected Clock.

objects.description: The UUIDs of the objects involved, sorted.

reason.description: Why it is waived. Left out when empty.

Zone.description:
A solid copper fill on one copper Layer, inside its outline, keeping clear of other
Nets' copper. Its fill is computed on demand and cached outside the Document. How it
joins Pads and Vias of its Net comes from the `zone_connection` rule.

clearance.description:
The gap kept to other Nets' copper. Left out, the clearance rule applies; set, the
larger of it and the rule applies.

follows_outline.description:
Whether the outline is the Board Outline, following its later edits; the fill
keeps the edge clearance from it. Left out when false.

locked.description: Locked against geometry changes; left out when false.

min_island_area.description:
Pieces of fill smaller than this, in square nanometres, are dropped, connected or
not.

min_width.description:
The narrowest copper the fill may leave: thinner necks are removed. Left out, the
Net's `track_width` minimum.

name.description:
Its typed name, unique on the board. Left out, it shows a name derived from the
board's [`ZoneNameScheme`], which is never stored.

net.description: Its PCB Net; left out for a fill on no Net.

pour_over.description: How the fill treats same-Net Zones and Tracks.

priority.description:
Where Zones overlap, the higher priority fills first and the others keep clear
of it.

remove_unconnected.description:
Whether pieces of fill that touch no copper of the Net are dropped. No effect on a
Zone with no Net.

shelved.description:
Whether it is shelved: kept in the file but hidden from the canvas and skipped by
fill, DRC, connectivity and outputs. Left out when false.

vertices.description:
The outline the fill stays inside; the last vertex joins the first. Empty while
the Zone [follows the Board Outline](Self::follows_outline).

ZoneConnection.description:
How a Zone fill joins a Pad of its own Net. Each value left out inherits from the
`zone_connection` rule.

angle.description: 0, 45 or 90 degrees in the Pad's frame.

gap.description: The clear ring around a relieved or unconnected Pad.

spoke_width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

ZoneCutout.description:
A Zone Cutout: removes the fill of every Zone on its copper Layer inside its outline,
exactly to its edge. It belongs to no one Zone and is never plotted.

layer.description: The copper Layer whose Zones it cuts.

vertices.description: The outline; the last vertex joins the first.

ZoneNameScheme.description:
How a Zone with no typed name is named: its Net (`NONET` for none), its copper Layer
as `Lxx` (copper number) or by name, and `Pxxx`, counting the Zones of that Net and
Layer in priority order.

oneOf.description: Such as `GND_L01_P000`.
Such as `L01_GND_P000`.
Such as `GND_Top_P000`.
Such as `Top_GND_P000`.

board_outline.description: The board's edge; left out while the board has none.

dimensions.description: The Dimensions; left out while the board has none. Their values are derived.

footprint_copies.description: The part table: a copy of each Footprint in use, sorted by UUID.

footprints.description: The placed Footprint instances, sorted by UUID.

format.description: The file-format version. REDA writes only the current one.

free_pads.description: Pads that belong to no Footprint, sorted by UUID; left out while there are none.

graphics.description:
Lines, arcs and rectangles on copper, silkscreen, mechanical and documentation
Layers.

keepouts.description: The Keepouts; left out while the board has none.

layers.description: The Layers, top to bottom. Objects name a Layer by its UUID.

net_classes.description: The Net Classes besides the Default Net Class, which is not stored.

output_origin.description:
The Output Origin: the zero of a `relative` preset's Gerber, drill and CPL, and of
the editor's coordinates and grid; left out while it is not set.

pcb.description: The PCB Document's identity; it matches its entry in the Project file.

rules.description: The design rule records: one board-wide record per kind, and Net Class records.

severities.description: The severity of each DRC check.

stackups.description: The board's physical build: one Stackup in v0.1.

texts.description: Free text on copper, silkscreen, mechanical and documentation Layers.

tracks.description: The copper Track segments; left out while the board has none.

vias.description: The Vias; left out while the board has none.

waivers.description: The Waivers of DRC Violations, sorted by UUID; left out while the board has none.

zone_cutouts.description: The Zone Cutouts; left out while the board has none.

zones.description:
The copper Zones (outlines and settings, never fills); left out while the board
has none.
